Wellness Warehouse has **over 50 physical stores** across South Africa, alongside its nationwide online shopping platform. [](https://wellnesswarehouse.com/pages/about-us)

- **Nationwide Footprint:** The retailer operates more than 50 brick-and-mortar branches primarily concentrated in major economic hubs like the Western Cape, Gauteng, and KwaZulu-Natal. [](https://wellnesswarehouse.com/pages/about-us)

- **Flagship Locations:** Their larger stores (such as the founding branch on Kloof Street in Cape Town) often feature integrated Wellness Cafés, pharmacies, and treatment spas alongside standard retail. [](https://whichfranchise.co.za/franchise/wellness-warehouse-franchise-for-sale/)

- **Exact Locations:** You can look up specific addresses, operating hours, and contact details for your closest branch using the official [Wellness Warehouse Store Locator](https://wellnesswarehouse.com/pages/store-locator?srsltid=AfmBOorIHJddkcmf4CjlPoajKgtCO4IeuJD8knPuA1LTsN-fwKUtGGRe).

Wearable Health Technologies
If you want to track your vitals, sleep, or metabolic health, consider these main categories of devices available through specialized electronics and medical platforms:
Continuous Glucose Monitors (CGMs):
Devices like the
Stelo Wearable Glucose Biosensor
or Abbott Lingo measure interstitial glucose levels in real time, helping users monitor how food, exercise, and sleep affect blood sugar.
Smartwatches & Wearable ECG:
Modern smartwatches (such as select Apple, Samsung, or specialized fitness watches) use built-in electrical sensors to capture single-lead ECG waveforms, screen for abnormal heart rhythms like atrial fibrillation, and monitor blood oxygen (SpO₂).
